home.h1: A spotless car, washed in your driveway.
home.intro: We come to your home or office, bring our own water and power, and leave your car cleaner than the day you bought it.

steps.d: Use the form or WhatsApp. Tell us where the car is and when.
We bring water, power and everything else. You carry on with your day.
Check the car first, then pay by card, EFT or cash.

home.areasText: Not on the list? Message us. If we’re nearby that day, we’ll come.

reviews.q: They washed my car in the office parking while I was in meetings. It looked new.
On time, friendly, and the inside smells clean for the first time in years.
Booked on WhatsApp in two minutes. Easiest errand of my week.

faq.q: Do you bring your own water and power?
faq.a: Yes. Our van carries water and a quiet generator, so we only need space around the car.
Card, EFT or cash, after you’ve checked the car.
We’ll message you the day before to move your booking at no charge.

faq.q: Can you do a fleet or several cars?
faq.a: Yes. Ask for a quote and we’ll plan a visit that suits your business.

services.h1: Pick a wash. We bring the rest.
services.intro: Prices are per car and include travel within our areas. Bakkies and 7-seaters add R 40.

items.name: Interior deep clean
items.summary: Seats shampooed, stains lifted, smells gone.
included: Vents, seams and cup holders detailed

items.name: Polish and wax
items.summary: A deep shine that keeps rain and dust off for weeks.

showcase.eyebrow: Showcase project 3 of 4 · Website and admin
showcase.intro: A fast site for a brand-new business, and a simple admin to keep it current. Switch between the two below, or play one of the stories.
showcase.demoNote: This is a demo with sample data. Tsela Mobile Wash is a made-up business, and its prices, reviews and enquiries are invented. The browser and phone are our own drawings.
showcase.idleCaption: Two views of one business. Customers see a calm, quick site. You see a few clear screens to keep it current.

steps.caption: A customer in Hatfield finds you. She opens your site on her phone and taps Book a wash.
She fills in four fields. Name, number, area and the wash she wants. Then Send request.
She knows what happens next. The sent message says you’ll confirm within [reply time].
It lands in your admin, and your email. Everything she typed, ready for a reply on WhatsApp or email.

enquiry.done: No missed customers. Every enquiry is in one place, with a reply button.

steps.caption: Prices went up this month. Open Services & prices and tap the wash to change.
Change the number, then Save. Saving keeps it as a draft. Nothing changes for customers yet.
One change is waiting. The bar at the bottom shows it. Tap Publish when you’re ready.
Your site is updated. The new price shows everywhere it appears. You could undo for 10 seconds.

price.done: Two minutes, no developer. You changed it, checked it and published it yourself.

steps.caption: Your gallery is empty. The site still looks finished. When you have photos, tap Upload photos.
Three photos from your phone. They upload, get a short description, and wait for you to publish.
Your gallery fills in. Before-and-after pairs, sized to load quickly on any phone.

photos.done: Photos whenever you have them. The site looked finished before, and better after.

showcase.offPathHint: This story follows one path. Tap the highlighted button, or use Next step.

Room to add bookings, payments or a shop later, without starting again
